notes.title: Happy New Ya Die!
notes.content:
Welcome to 2019, Darrens! 

The team is working on new art for level 2, and damn it, it's going to be an exciting year for this brutal little puzzle and party game.

Here's how we kicked the year off, with 8/10 review from [url=https://www.starburstmagazine.com/reviews/the-dark-room]from the UK's premier science fiction magazine, Starburst![/url]

Kick arse out there, everybody!

John

notes.title: Merry Christmas, Darrens!
notes.content:
Hello, Darrens!

It's the night before Christmas, and all through the house, a creature is stirring, and you're going die. 

(No, it doesn't rhyme, but when you're dashing through the room, while a white-haired demon slays, you don't have time for poetry.)

The Dark Room: Level One has just gotten a rave review from PC Powerplay magazine in Australia. I'm delighted! I've think I've successfully posted the photo on here, but if not [url=https://www.facebook.com/johnrobertsoncomedy/photos/a.398071028929/10156688670098930/?type=3&theater] here's the link.[/url]

The team are having a break over the holiday period, but we'll be back soon, and soon the elves that weren't busy assembling toys for Santa will return to the job of assembling deathtraps for Darrens. 

Love to all,

John

notes.title: Post - PAX Aus + DYKG
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

Been awhile! I've been on tour! 

PAX Australia was a blast - we sold out of printed Steam Keys and t-shirts, but there's good news for folks who'd like to buy a The Dark Room pin down the line... stay tuned. 

The Dark Room live show went off - a beautiful full theatre, I filmed it - and so did PAX on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/327946521]Twitch[/url]!

In Halloween news, The Dark Room was the voice for the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YUIjevVewJU]Did You Know Gaming Extra Halloween Special[/url]

And our team of hard-working programmers (it's one guy) is squashing bugs while plans for Level 2's delivery get put together. 

Nobody's gotten the Kafka achievement yet. x

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Build 0.11.1!
notes.content:
Hello, Darrens!

Welcome to the new build! Here's what we've got:

1. One of the causes of the infamous Fatal Error has been destroyed! If you're still experiencing the Fatal Error, please let us know!

2. Four new Achievements have been added! Good luck getting "Kafka". 

3. Graphics options are now available on the "Options" screen. 

4. Some subtitle fixes, more being rolled out as we go. 

Our priority in the next bugfix is the Checkpoint-Just-Before-Death error. 

YA DIE

notes.title: 21/10 - Update 0.8.0 + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey, Darrens!

New update! Version 0.8.0 includes the following features and bug fixes: 

1. Music is now in the game!

2. If you "reached level 2" and glitched yesterday, that was an old exit from a previous build - try again! Your exits are now... in another castle. 

3. THERE IS ONE TRUE PATH TO ESCAPE LEVEL ONE, AND SO FAR NOBODY HAS FOUND IT YET. A SACRIFICE WILL BE NECESSARY. 

4. Hard Mode / Adjust Brightness has now been made genuinely hard. 

As always, please report bugs here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/918530/discussions/0/1735465524701614928/

If you want to, please leave us a nice review on Steam. 

And if you want to send theories, maps or questions hit up @Robbotron on Twitter.

notes.title: THE GAME IS OUT!
notes.content:
Ah, I'm so happy! The game is finally out! 

Welcome to Level One of The Dark Room! 

It wasn't always our plan to release the game in parts, but I think the team at Stirfire and I have put together a damn good adventure that you'll really enjoy/ become insane with rage at - especially when you realise how many changes we can slide into the updates when the game is literally folks being trapped in a dark room. 

There's 60 minutes of specially-created mo-cap footage in this level alone, and a host of puzzles and traps. Good luck. I'm going to see how you all do getting out of level one before I offer a reward. :-) 

So, my point is - we're here, it's going to be great - and The Dark Room will expand as we go! If you're thinking of buying it, get in now - it's 10% off, and your money helps fund the rest of the development costs, so we can bring you levels 2, 3 and Darkest as fast as we can. 

I LOOK FORWARD TO HAVING YOU ON THIS JOURNEY. 

THE DARK ROOM IS EVOLVING. AND IT WILL TAKE YOU WITH IT, DARREN.

notes.title: The Dark Room In UK Comedy Press
notes.content:
Howdy folks! We're 4 days out from release! 

So, have some news stories! 

After six years of touring The Dark Room live show across the UK, Australia, South-East Asia and every place on the planet that isn't America (I like America, just haven't been over yet), the UK comedy press celebrates the release of The Dark Room game with: 

"John Robertson's Cult Show Dark Room Becomes Proper Video Game".
